## Activity

During October 2025, North City Eye Clinic completed 480 photographic captures. This represents the recorded activity for the reporting month. The service activity was documented for operational monitoring and review.

## Image quality

Of the 480 captures, 8 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.7%. These captures could not be used for grading and are included in the site’s image-quality results for October 2025. The rate provides a measure of the proportion of captures requiring consideration in relation to overall activity.

## Grading

Grading identified 119 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This result is reported alongside the activity and image-quality measures to support review of the service’s performance during October 2025.

Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month. The available results should be considered together when reviewing activity levels, image quality, and grading timeliness at North City Eye Clinic.
